LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Gecko.label: Gecko
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Gecko.description: A close-range armored variant of the Iguana, built to hold streets and breach buildings. Its plating is thickened well beyond the base chassis, and an add-on array of electromagnetic reactive armor bricks negates shaped charges and explosives outright. The extra tonnage makes it slower and more expensive than the Iguana, and its weapon options are limited to short-range heavy arms.

LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Iguana.label: Iguana
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Iguana.description: The modernized, redesigned bipedal walking tank based on the Tarbosaurus. Small, cheap and suited to mass production, it is the modular model of the line: its weapon mount takes a wide range of heavy weapons, so it can be refitted for the mission at hand. It carries no electromagnetic reactive armor and its base plating is moderate, relying on its mobility and smoke launchers to survive.
